articleTitle: Research and Design of Intelligent Educational Administration Management System Based on Biometrics
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of universities and colleges scale, the reform of higher education teaching mode and the construction of ‘Double First-class’ universities, the complexity and diversity of educational administration business logic are also increasing, and the existing educational administration system can not meet the needs. In order to improve the educational management level of the college and improve the efficiency of educational management, the development of software and hardware related to educational management is in full swing. The educational management system based on biometric technology is born. The system provides hardware services based on biometrics technology and software services based on mobile terminal technology to provide convenient and efficient services for teachers and students.

articleTitle: AI+5G Empowers the Construction of a Smart Learning Space for Private Higher Vocational Education in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The integration of new-generation information technologies such as AI and 5G into education provide strong technical support for private colleges and universities to implement teaching reforms and achieve the goals of smart education. The new generation of information technologies such as AI and 5G play an important role in empowering the construction of smart learning spaces, and play a very important role in the development of private higher education in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Therefore, the construction of AI+5G empowered smart learning space should be based on the learning concept of the smart era, with smart education as the goal, and the teaching effectiveness of smart learning space to achieve effective improvement of teaching quality. To promote the agglomeration and development of private higher education in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Status Quo and Strategies of Chinese for Children in Hong Kong Based on Online Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: With the rise of China's international status and the popularity of the Chinese language boom, more and more people are choosing to learn Chinese as a second language, while more and more learners from abroad, such as children from Hong Kong and Macau, are learning Mandarin as a key language. With advances in technology and technological innovations, the way people learn languages has changed: from the traditional large offline physical classroom to online online classes. With the impact of the new coronary epidemic, it has become difficult for traditional teaching models to work properly offline, so more and more learners are choosing to learn Chinese in online classes. Because they are not restricted by time and place, families who are able to do so choose to enrol their children in online Chinese (Mandarin) classes to enhance their children's language skills and cultural awareness. In this paper, we analyse the characteristics of Hong Kong children and the main problems faced by children teaching Chinese in Hong Kong to show the current situation of online Chinese learning in Hong Kong and provide relevant strategies for those who are engaged in related professions.

articleTitle: Application of virtual reality technology in experimental teaching of medical specialty
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the application advantages of virtual reality technology in medical experiment teaching, and integrates the construction and structure of medical experiment teaching system. The application of virtual reality technology in medical experiment teaching can timely solve the problem of low simulation degree in clinical experiment teaching, and design a knowledge teaching system according to practical knowledge and theoretical knowledge. Experimental interactive model and 3d model system of virtual reality technology can improve the interaction of medical experiment learning and make students master the operation process of medical knowledge more easily. At the same time, using the virtual visualization function of virtual reality technology, medical experiment teaching can quickly simulate various organs of the human body and the diseased parts of patients, so as to provide students with fast surgery, which greatly realizes the development of intelligent operation of medical experiment teaching and builds a comprehensive medical experiment teaching model. Virtual reality technology provides strong technical support for the development of medical experiment teaching.

articleTitle: Analysis on psychological model of ‘involution’ and ‘tang ping’ of first-class college students under engineering technology
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: With the increasingly intense competition in colleges and universities, the term “involution” appeared and has become popular in many students' daily use to indicate irrational competition. The opposite of “involution” is “tang ping” (lying flat), meaning that “faced with great competitive pressure, people no longer aspire to success and reduce their desire”. In this research, the psychological model of “involution” and “tang ping” among college students is analyzed under an engineering technology. Premised on a certain proportion of college students in terms of school types, grades and genders, the research is conducted through Wenjuanxing, an online survey tool, supported by reports and data. Then a visual and multi-dimensional analysis of the psychological model of “involution” and “tang ping” among college students of different grades in Project 985 universities, Project 211 universities, or other key universities is made. Finally, effective measures to mitigate such phenomena are proposed.

articleTitle: Smart Customer Experience of ESG Education Capability Building Roadmap for Smart Consulting, Reporting and Engaging for Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Goals
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Cultivating talents for executing environmental, social, and governance (ESG) activities is increasingly essential for the education sector. It is because the social and ecological resilience of the human society depends on guiding human development towards sustainability. To prepare future professionals to manage climate change and the Covid-19 pandemic recovery challenges, the article proposes several ESG educational models, based on and design workshop outcomes using stakeholder analysis and the ESG and carbon neutrality research. Three partner maps for ESG consulting, reporting, and engaging have been developed, with special attention on the use of digital technologies to manage carbon emission for green and just transitions. Based on these maps, a model “Smart Customer System on Carbon Information” is proposed. The model highlights the importance of collaboration across professions such as management, accounting, public administration, public relations, communications, business intelligence, and data sciences, resulting in an integrated capability building roadmap among stakeholders. Future education practices and research must advance and facilitate the overall “smart customer journey” of carbon emission reporting in order to account for ESG records for a net-zero carbon-neutral future, with the help of information and communication technologies.

articleTitle: Innovation of Audio-visual Teaching Modes of TCSOL Based on “Tik Tok”
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: In the era of big data, the great development of internet invades every aspect of daily life, and changes the developing direction of various industries. With the fast development of digital media, it influences the booming developing career of Chinese international teaching under the field of education as well. Recently, short video Apps, such as Tik Tok, Wesee and kuaishou, come into vogue, which has become an important power in the field of new-media and teaching by short video apps also greatly affects the filed of teaching Chinese to speakers of other languages. This passage will set about from the example of teaching Chinese to other language speakers on “Tik Tok”, and talk about the pros and coins of this new prevailed Chinese teaching modes. Then it will put forward some suggestions about optimizing and improving this modes in order to facilitate the innovation and development of international Chinese teaching under the background of “digital economy”.

articleTitle: Establishment of Higher Education Evaluation System Based on Global Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: In order to help the state formulate a reasonable policy for the reform of the higher education system, we first establish a model for evaluating the health of the national higher education system by using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), the model is used to evaluate several typical countries. Then combined with the specific situation of our country's higher education, it puts forward the targeted improvement measures and policies for our country, and establishes the prediction model of the development of higher education system. Finally, we were able to arrive at a reasonable vision and a concrete implementation timetable.

articleTitle: Strategies for Online Teaching of Chinese as a Second Language
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The emergence of the COVID-19 is a challenge and an opportunity for the education industry. Under the environment of the pandemic, Teaching Chinese as a Second Language (TCSL) has responded to the call of the country and the needs of the times by developing online teaching, using modern information technology to enable foreign students to continue learning Chinese. And the online teaching mode can still be retained as a new teaching mode after the pandemic is controlled. However, in the process of online TCSL, some defects and shortcomings of online teaching are gradually revealed, which have a certain negative impact on students' Chinese learning. This article analyzes the impact of the pandemic on the TCSL and emphasizes the urgency of online teaching in the pandemic environment. At the same time, this article explores the challenges faced by online TCSL and proposes strategies, putting forward personal thoughts and suggestions for the progress and optimization of online TCSL.

Author Keywords: Teaching Chinese as a Second Language

articleTitle: Online and offline integrated teaching model
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: As the 2020 new crown pneumonia epidemic swept the world, during the epidemic prevention and control period, students learning Chinese could not be taught offline, but the teaching progress could not be stopped, so many schools adopted online teaching mode to teach. It is not only a test of teachers' teaching technology, but also a test of science and technology information technology. Online teaching requires both teachers and students to have an electronic facility, to find areas where the network is more fluid for teaching, and to be able to use an online teaching software and so on. In this paper, from the point of view of using Ding TALK in teaching process, the function of Ding TALK software in teaching process is analyzed to promote the reform and innovation of traditional Chinese as a foreign language model, to promote the formation of a fixed teaching model of online and offline integrated teaching, and to improve the quality of Chinese as a foreign language.

articleTitle: A study of frequency-based and mobile terminal-based deep learning of college English vocabulary
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: In the era of rapid development of artificial intelligence, mobile English vocabulary APP has become the primary way for college students to learn English vocabulary. At present, the effect of English vocabulary mobile learning on students' vocabulary acquisition is not satisfactory. Therefore, it is essential to analyze the causes and propose solution strategies. This paper explores the four major elements of improving students' vocabulary width and depth based on the frequency effect, deep learning, coverage, practice frequency, and automaticity. Also, automaticity is a prerequisite to alleviate lexical fossilization. A repetition rate of 5–15 times a word is a prerequisite for long-term vocabulary retention [14], while the frequency of practice and vocabulary automaticity are positive variables that contribute to the transformation of passive vocabulary into automatic vocabulary, leading to vocabulary learning with higher-order thinking and ultimately to the transformation of automatic vocabulary into the active vocabulary. The teacher plays a role in assisting students to adjust their learning mood in their autonomous deep vocabulary learning. Therefore, This paper provides a theoretical basis for optimizing English vocabulary APP and English vocabulary teaching and helps students improve vocabulary ability through efficient and autonomous deep learning methods.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of online teacher teaching team on students' active learning based on Internet information system data
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: More and more Internet information is used to evaluate the degree of students' active learning, but few are combined with online teachers' teaching team. In order to study the effect of an online teacher teaching team on students' active learning and the difference between different gender and educational background, through the questionnaire based on Internet information system, this paper randomly sampled 553 students from colleges and universities at different levels in a region, and used SAS statistical analysis software to statistically analyze the data by chi square test, t-test and other statistical methods. The results show that students with different gender and educational background have different expectations for the number of online teaching teacher teams that can play an active role in learning; Students of engineering technology have lower scores on the current status of online teachers' teaching team; The promoting effect of an online teacher teaching team on active learning is mainly reflected in many aspects, such as enabling students to achieve better positive learning effect, reducing learning burden, improving the motivation to achieve positive learning objectives and generating positive learning motivation. Its positive role has been widely recognized by students. Therefore, when the school is equipped with online teaching team, it should comprehensively consider the differences between students' needs and educational background.

articleTitle: Application and Development Prospect of Artificial Intelligence in Quality Education
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The integration of education and artificial intelligence has become an important trend of educational reform. With the continuous deepening of the application of artificial intelligence in the field of education, the popularization of artificial intelligence in primary and secondary schools is facing many problems, such as curriculum system and curriculum standards, teaching modes and methods, teachers, class hours, teaching venues and teaching aids. Therefore, a collection and analysis platform for education big data is built. The platform can collect and integrate student data and teaching data. Focusing on the modern development direction of intelligence, starting with the construction of intelligent system, build an intelligent education management system with advanced technology, cultivate the intelligent literacy of educatees, and promote the further integration and development of education and artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Application of virtual reality technology in the creation of College English interactive dialogue scene
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Virtual reality technology is a complex technology formed by human-computer interaction. Only on the basis of fully understanding the evolution rules of virtual software technology system can it provide technical support for English interactive scene creation system. This paper mainly discusses the structure, type, data model and information characteristics of virtual software system created by interactive scene. At the same time, based on the application of virtual reality technology, computer theory is used to analyze the evolution law of interactive scene system from the scale and structure of interactive scene virtual network. In the construction of virtual reality interactive dialogue scene system, the interactive dialogue scene software system with virtual reality technology as the core should provide a strong technical guarantee for the development and establishment of College English interactive dialogue scene.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of family factors on college students' career choice based on SPSS software
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: This study takes the full-time college students in Hangzhou Xiasha Higher Education Park as the research object, adopts the quantitative research method, deeply analyzes how family factors affect college students' job-seeking process and explores how family capital affects college students' employment cognition and employment expectation. This study will explore the relationship between family capital and college students' employment intention through a questionnaire survey. By collecting 236 sample data of College Students' employment intention on the Internet, using SPSS 25 software to make descriptive analysis, correlation analysis, difference analysis, and regression analysis on the data, this paper discusses the impact of family capital on personal, professional status in today's society. Family research results show that family social capital factors include father's occupation and father's work unit, which greatly impact College Students' employment intention. Finally, the researchers put forward relevant research suggestions: first, families respect college students' freedom of employment and provide strong support for job hunting; second, master students improve their employment confidence and reduce the family capital shortage on employment.

articleTitle: Be based on Interactive situational English teaching design based on VR technology
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the data information of virtual reality technology model in English teaching situation design. This paper mainly analyzes from the level of interactive situation, using VR technology to develop English learning scenes, abandoning the development and design of human-computer interaction teaching process, and introduces 3d modeling technology and model construction, image display production technology and virtual English 3D scene construction. Its main principle is to use 3D Max and Unity3D engine to build English stereo vision, so as to build the 3D model view required by English teaching. Therefore, virtual reality technology provides technical support for English situational teaching design, and accelerates the intelligent development of English teaching, so as to comprehensively promote the development of English situational teaching design and realize the comprehensive construction of English situational teaching system.

articleTitle: “Hypercycle” Learning System Based on “Extension Classroom”: Take Online Music Teaching During the COVID-19 Pandemic As An Example
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to provide an information interactive platform of teaching and learning, for self-learning diagnosis. We expand classroom teaching into an open teaching system consisting of “before class” (online), “in class” (online or offline) and “after class” (online), which is called “extension classroom”. This paper uses the method of complex system analysis to evaluate the students' learning state in “before class” and “after class” and concludes that the key to effective teaching and learning is that teachers clearly know how to teach and students know how to learn. This kind of teaching mechanism is realized in “extension classroom” with supercycle. We applied the “extension classroom” to the teaching of music performance during the COVID-19 pandemic, and the results showed that 65% of students improved their self-diagnosis ability, 46% had satisfactory communication with teachers, and 20% had a significant increase in learning performance.

articleTitle: A Study of the Characteristics and Extraction of Buzzwords Based on DCC
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The definition, characteristics, categories, curve of the evolution of buzzwords and three methods of extracting buzzwords are discussed in the DCC dynamic circulation corpus. The buzzword refers to a word which is widely and rapidly spread in a certain period or a certain range. Nominal buzzwords account for a vast majority of buzzwords, while verbs account for only a minority. The proportion of two syllables is not very high, and the proportion of four syllables is the highest, followed by three syllables, and then five syllables. The proportion of nine syllables and above is also on the rise. Words with different number of syllables must be segmented to extract buzzwords. The full segmentation method to extract buzzword candidates can achieve more ideal results.

articleTitle: A Study on the Influence of Data-driven TCM English Corpus on Teachers' Job Burnout in ESP Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: To investigate the current situation of teachers' job burnout in ESP teaching in a domestic college of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), and put forward the data-driven model of TCM English corpus to effectively improve job burnout. Methods: using the method of random sampling, teachers (n=30) were selected for grouping experiments. The self-made TCM English Corpus Data-driven Effectiveness Scale and Maslach Burnout Inventory-Educators Survey (MBI-ES) were used for measurement, and the relevant data were statistically analyzed by SPSS 24.0. Results: 1 The teachers' job burnout in ESP teaching in Colleges and universities of TCM was at a serious level; 2 The data-driven effectiveness of TCM English corpus can alleviate teachers' job burnout; 3 The data-driven effectiveness of TCM English corpus can significantly predict teachers' job burnout. Conclusion: Based on the data-driven theory, the effective application of TCM English Corpus in ESP teaching can solve the problem of job burnout faced by English teachers.

articleTitle: The Application Path of Artificial Intelligence Technologies in Precision Teaching of College English
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The development of artificial intelligence has made education step into the intelligence age. AI technologies are not only applied to language practice but also pedagogically contribute to English learning. U sing precision teaching as theoretical framework, this paper discusses how to apply big-data modeling, human-computer interaction, smart push system, etc. in the four teaching stages: students profiling, teaching resource customization, teaching methods optimization and assessment of student's performance in college English. It is concluded that with the assistance of AI technologies, the individualized English education can be achieved.

articleTitle: Study on Cross-cultural Competence Cultivation of Chinese EFL Learners Based on Information Technology Platform under the Background of Internet +
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: With the continuous emergence of new technologies such as mobile Internet, cloud computing, Internet of Things and Internet +, information technology has been widely used in various fields of society, and has also brought about subversive changes in college education. Cultivating Chinese EFL learners' intercultural communicative competence is the popular trend of current development of education, also caters to the needs of China's development. The convenience provided by the Internet, students can better adapt to different cultural environments. Therefore, based on information technology under the background of Internet +, the cultivation of intercultural communication ability by Chinese EFL learners will greatly influence the development of the world economy, boost the development of international politics and culture, and further promote the steady and long-term development of the world economy. According to the meaning and content of intercultural competence, this paper analyzes the current situation of intercultural learning of Chinese EFL learners under the different new information technology platform under the background of Internet +, and puts forward training methods, hoping to provide effective methods for the educational practice of cultivating intercultural communication competence.

articleTitle: Teaching analysis research based on mobile learning
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology and the wide application of multimedia intelligent technology in teaching, mobile learning mode has become a big development trend. This paper describes the theoretical basis of mobile learning, and comprehensively analyzes the deficiencies of the current “online mobile learning” teaching mode in colleges and universities, and puts forward solutions to these problems. On this basis, the mobile learning English teaching mode is constructed in colleges and universities, which gives full play to the advantages of the new teaching mode. The new English teaching model has greatly improved students' self-study ability, fully utilized Internet resources, expanded the student's foreign language learning resource library, and can use the Internet to build an authentic speaking and listening learning environment. The new English teaching model makes full use of the advantages of mobile resources to enrich college English classrooms.

articleTitle: A Brief Analysis on Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language with the Assistance of New Media Technology under the New Crown Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Since the outbreak of the new crown, the Chinese as a foreign language education industry has been greatly affected, a large number of overseas Confucius Institutes have been suspended from classes, and domestic Chinese volunteers can not be sent out. The epidemic situation makes the development of Confucius Institutes and Chinese international education major face great challenges. In the face of such a dilemma, Confucius Institute launched the call to stop classes, break through the traditional teaching mode, and move the Chinese as a foreign language classroom from offline to online, thus giving birth to a new mode of education. Chinese as a foreign language teaching under the new mode thanks to the rapid development of the Internet industry, the emergence of the “Internet +” era makes the application of new media technology in teaching Chinese as a foreign language become a reality. With the rapid development of network information technology and the application of 5 G technology, new media, as a new means of content dissemination, has changed the teaching method and teaching mode of Chinese as a foreign language. Focusing on the development of teaching Chinese as a foreign language under the condition of Newcastle disease, this paper analyzes the application of new media technology in teaching Chinese as a foreign language from the mode of “Internet +” and the new challenges and opportunities brought to the Chinese international education industry.

Author Keywords: teaching Chinese as a foreign language

articleTitle: Analysis of the transformation of Chinese teaching mode based on “flipped classroom” to “online”
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology today, the subject of Chinese as a foreign language is constantly updating its own teaching mode. Especially during the COVID-19 epidemic, the Ministry of Education issued the notice of “no suspension of classes”. The teaching mode has changed from offline teaching to online teaching. This article mainly analyzes the changes of the two Chinese teaching modes from “flipped classroom” to “online”, and compares the two teaching modes. The research method mainly adopts literature analysis, PowerPoint and combines personal practical experience. The comparison reveals that the teaching environment is different, and that the “flipped classroom” mainly focuses on offline classroom teaching, while the “online” mainly focuses on various platforms. The teaching time, teaching methods, teaching materials and examination evaluation are all different. The purpose of this paper is to gain some inspiration for teaching Chinese as a foreign language “online” through the comparison of the two teaching modes.

articleTitle: Application and Research of Art Design Informatization Teaching under big data
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The rapid development of technology has made information technology penetrate into all aspects of education, and the networked and digital education system makes art education more open and creative, however, due to historical reasons, the application of art design teaching informatization is somewhat lagging behind. This paper analyzes the shortcomings of art and design education model and the advantages of teaching informatization, and argues the four aspects of art and design informatization from the application environment, transformation and application, online and offline, and intelligent management, in order to establish the online and offline teaching model, strengthen the concept of art education informatization in colleges and universities, correctly look at the relationship between art and technology, and equip advanced educational software and hardware. It is an effective way to realize the informatization of art and design teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Utilization of Network Resource Base of Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language under Digital Humanities Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The progress of science and technology and the popularization of network education have made great changes in the teaching and learning mode of teaching Chinese as a foreign language. The convenience of the network provides a large number of learning resources and platforms for students to learn Chinese. It is convenient for students and teachers with the same learning hobbies to communicate and discuss. Using the principle of computer information retrieval technology, a large number of resources are organized and stored in a certain way and law to form a set of information. Users can use specific retrieval instructions, search words and retrieval strategies to quickly and efficiently find information according to their own needs. Many teachers of Chinese as a foreign language are willing to share the problems and solutions encountered in their teaching process on the Internet, its content is becoming more and more abundant, and the network resource bank of Chinese as a foreign language is becoming more and more perfect. This paper will briefly outline what is the network teaching resource bank of Chinese as a foreign language, the advantages and disadvantages of its utilization and the advantages and disadvantages of the network resources of teaching Chinese as a foreign language, and hope that computer research and development personnel and teachers of Chinese as a foreign language will cooperate. Strive to develop more computer information retrieval resources suitable for teachers of Chinese as a foreign language.

Author Keywords: Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Application of College Students' Ideological and Political Education APP
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: This paper starts with strengthening the APP design of ideological and political education for college students, and comprehensively analyzes the APP design and application according to the needs of ideological and political education. In the design of the APP, mobile terminal and system platform correlation technology are the main technologies, and the network architecture and database form are adopted to strengthen the integration platform construction of mobile terminal and computer system. Choose B\S architecture mode, network communication technology, cloud sharing technology, etc., to strengthen the effect of mobile applications and data applications, thus laying a solid foundation for the APP framework and system construction of ideological and political education for college students in China.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Network Platform in Teaching Spanish Reading
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Spanish was once considered a minor language in our country. However, with the increasingly frequent exchanges between China, Spain and Latin America in political, economic, trade, and cultural exchanges, society has an increasing demand for Spanish-speaking talents. Many colleges and universities in China now offer this major. Compared with English, our country has a late start in the teaching of Spanish, and there are still some shortcomings in the curriculum and teaching methods. In order to solve these problems, this article also explores the application of network platform technology in the teaching of Spanish Reading course. It is found that network technology can be used to enrich course resources, expand teaching content, change the main body of the course, and build a network platform for students. Corresponding network modules have developed a brand-new teaching system, and can use online and offline innovative examination functions, and finally effectively improve the teaching effect of the ‘Spanish Reading’ course system

articleTitle: VR technology applied to traditional dance
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Virtual reality technology originated in the 20th century and is a new complex information technology with multimedia technology, sensor model, data calculation and other functions. VR technology, with its immersive virtual environment and sound effects, plays a huge role in traditional dance teaching. VR technology can realize multimedia intelligent teaching in traditional dance, and establish a THREE-DIMENSIONAL interactive model according to the needs of dance teaching, and construct a virtual teaching environment suitable for dance teaching. VR technology provides an ideal place for the training of dance teaching. The dance micro-training system based on virtual reality technology includes three modules: teaching scene model construction, virtual role construction and teaching environment model calculation. This paper mainly analyzes the interactive and model building functions of VR technology in dance teaching application.

articleTitle: Research on the Integrated Management System Based on B/S Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: According to the working practice of an office in Area A, a kind of integrated case management system is developed, which is fast, easy to expand and easy to operate. The system adopts b/s structure, configures sql server database, irreversibility encryption algorithm to ensure data security, at the same time, it realizes the unified management of the information of investigating and handling a case. It has been proved by engineering practice that the grass-roots staff and managers can update and control work progress conveniently, improve law enforcement efficiency and case handling quality, and strengthen law enforcement supervision.

articleTitle: Analysis of a new random multiple access protocol for wireless ad hoc networks based on n-csma
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: wireless ad hoc network communication is an important branch of the whole communication field. Its science and technology and application bring many conveniences to people's production and life. Wireless ad hoc network is composed of many nodes. The overall performance of nodes reflects the performance of the whole network. The network is self-organizing, so that nodes can join or exit arbitrarily. However, the life cycle of nodes is an important factor affecting the network, so in order to improve the energy efficiency of nodes, the transmission efficiency of nodes is very important.

articleTitle: Design of Web-based Information Management System for Ideological and Moral Quality Evaluation in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The ideological and moral quality evaluation is a fundamental part of the comprehensive quality assessment of college students. However, there are many uncontrollable factors and tedious paper queries in the manual evaluation, which reduces the evaluation efficiency and wastes resources. On the contrary, [1] computer operation can realize exact queries at any time, and is more convenient and fast in modification and statistics. To meet the needs, this paper analyzes the basic structure of the information management system for ideological and moral quality evaluation, and carries out design and research on the system content with ASP.NET as the programming language to achieve better efficacy of ideological and political education.

Author Keywords: ideological and moral quality in colleges and universities

articleTitle: Research on the Development and Operation Effect of the Innovation and entrepreneurship education network teaching platform in the Internet + Era
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The innovation and entrepreneurship education network teaching platform is a comprehensive network education platform constructed by using computer network technology that integrates teaching, teaching resource library management, and teaching management. This article first analyzes its construction background and necessity, and then explores the development and design of the innovation and entrepreneurship education network teaching platform on the basis of practice, and finally uses the analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to improve the satisfaction of W University's innovation and entrepreneurship education network teaching platform operation An evaluation study was carried out, and the study showed that the use of the online teaching platform not only greatly improved student satisfaction, but also promoted the improvement of innovation and entrepreneurship teaching quality.

articleTitle: The Construction and Practice of Precision Teaching Model of “Smart Class” based on “Internet + Education”
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Under the background of “Internet + Education” era, the innovation and reform of education is facing new opportunities and challenges. Based on the description and analysis of the connotation of “smart class” and its basic characteristics, this paper constructs a data-driven precision teaching model of the smart class, and applies this model to practical English teaching. From numerous angles including the smart learning platform settings, students' study analysis based on data stored in the smart campus system, teaching goals setting, classroom teaching activities design and precise teaching evaluation, this paper states and analyzes how this model adopts the new generation of information technology to realize the customized, intelligent, and adaptive learning requirements and programs for different students, and implement ubiquitous learning that runs through the whole process (pre-, in-, and post-class), and promote the students' learning motivation and the development of independent learning capability in order to achieve desired learning effect.

articleTitle: Construction of English smart classroom learning model based on big data technology
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: This paper specifically analyzes the constructive role and practical application function of big data technology in English smart classroom, and this paper fully improves the classroom model and designs the data model based on big data technology, and puts forward the function analysis of relevant smart classroom modules. The big data smart classroom system is mainly composed of three parts: English learning resource database, data model analysis, data storage and data evaluation. There is a large amount of data information in the application process of smart classroom. Therefore, using data information processing and data mining technology, we can develop new model functions based on the original functions of smart classroom, so as to further improve the technical framework for the teaching system. With the support of data information processing technology and data mining technology, English smart classroom learning system continues to carry out technological innovation, providing technical support for English classroom innovation.

articleTitle: Research on the Rise of Digital Humanities and the Turn of Literary Study Based on AntConc
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: This paper involves the way of applying corpus-based empirical analyses to the study of literature. Benjy's section in William Faulkner's The Sound and the Fury is used as the corpus and imported into AntConc 3.5.8 (Windows) 2019, a corpus analysis software able to identify textual features of an author or a particular text. With the help of AntConc, this paper explores the narrative, semantic, lexical and syntactic idiosyncrasies of the corpus so as to delve into the mind style of Benjy. It is found that the chaotic narrative order, the absence of human actor, the deviance in collocation, the limitation in lexis, the simplicity in sentence structure and the abundant use of direct speech are all clues to Benjy's uncomprehending mind. It is hoped that this paper can promote further integration of digital humanities and literary study.

articleTitle: Teaching Chinese on YouTube Based on Information Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The 21st century is the era of big data. With the rapid development of this trend, big data is not only used to collect information, but also more or less involved in various disciplines. In recent years, network teaching has become popular, especially in the past year. Under the influence of the COVID-19, network teaching websites and some APPs have begun to develop, which is a natural impact on the traditional teaching, but also a major reform of teaching methods. From the perspective of the trend of network teaching, this paper focuses on the study of YouTube, a popular video platform around the world, to find out the changes and advantages of Chinese teaching in the information age, and at the same time to analyze its disadvantages. It is concluded that Chinese teaching on YouTube is far from flourishing, and it is time for Chinese teachers to actively innovate. In addition, the impact of the current world epidemic has also made it difficult for offline teaching to operate normally, which is not only a challenge for Chinese teachers, but also an opportunity to follow the trend, use data, and enter the information age.

articleTitle: Applying digital technology to linguistic education: a connectivism-based intelligent learning system
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The advent of a highly interactive and networked digital era of Web 2.0 has greatly changed the way we view knowledge and the learning process. Knowledge is more reflected as an emerging dynamic network, rather than an attainable objective state. The learning process, as a result, is a process of network formation instead of knowledge transferring. With the acknowledgement of these transformations, this study sheds light on how to apply digital technology to linguistic education by matching up the digital learning theory of connectivism with the dynamic and emerging features of linguistics sources. By aggregating large-scale corpus into linguistic learning network, the study observes and evaluates how data extracting, model exploring, verifying and falsifying are interacted in students' linguistic learning process. It is demonstrated that this corpus-assisted digital learning approach, can not only promote students' acquisition in linguistics, but can also enhance students' learning abilities in general, such as problem-solving ability, data-mining ability, and online learning ability.

articleTitle: New ways of speech skills training in online Chinese teaching based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Under the influence of the new coronavirus epidemic, TCFL has been greatly impacted. Thanks to the development of Internet technology, many schools and institutions turn to online teaching, online live teaching, online course customization, mixed multiple teaching and other online teaching modes are widely used. This paper focuses on the necessity and problems of Chinese language skills training for foreign students under the online teaching mode, and discusses how to carry out language skills training in online Chinese teaching from four aspects of listening, speaking, reading and writing. Some suggestions are put forward, such as changing the way of classroom practice and strengthening students' self-training, using modern science and technology, network resources and online learning platform to provide more and more comprehensive teaching services for Chinese learners, and setting up incentive mechanism to mobilize students' enthusiasm. This paper hopes to provide some new teaching ideas, teaching methods and teaching approaches for online Chinese language skills training in the new era.

articleTitle: The design of outreach training focusing on the cultivation of higher-order thinking in the SPOC environment
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Core literacy advocates in-depth teaching with high-level thinking. Higher-order thinking is a key ability to adapt to the development of the knowledge age, and cultivating learners' higher-order thinking requires the design of new types of outreach training. Therefore, this article uses the FC knowledge modeling method, in the SPOC environment, through the design of the students to carry out the expansion training of high-level thinking, to promote deep learning, randomly selected two parallel classes in a middle school in Changsha City for teaching practice research, using SPSS24 for significant analysis and evaluation of the effect of the implementation of the expansion design. The conclusions drawn are as follows. Using the strategy of instructional design that focuses on higher-order thinking expansion design can improve the teaching effect. students who use high-order thinking expansion design in the SPOC environment are better than other students in problem-solving ability. This enlightens us to make full use of SPOC curriculum resources and pay attention to students' higher-order thinking training and developmental evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on the cultivation of College Students' cross-cultural communicative competence based on Immersive artificial intelligence multimedia technology
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Integrate cultural knowledge into classroom teaching, and carry out various teaching activities with the help of the cultivation strategy of College Students' cross-cultural communicative competence based on Immersive artificial intelligence multimedia technology and “Ai + education”. This paper defines the three-dimensional data management view of user data management task, and puts forward a multi view interaction method for multi block data management of College Students' cross-cultural communicative competence flow field in immersive environment. This method uses the combination of three-dimensional data management view and main view to jointly complete the interactive task of multi block flow field data management in immersive environment.

articleTitle: The Relationship Between Antitrust and Privacy Protection in the Digital Age and the Construction of Data Control Supervision Model
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: This paper explores the root cause of the difficulty in using antitrust policy to promote privacy protection in the digital age. It is more and more important to prevent the lack of competition and privacy security risks brought by big data. Since the antitrust policy is ineffective in remedying privacy violations, it is not advisable to include privacy security issues into the antitrust framework for analysis. By establishing an appropriate data control supervision model that enables the competition law enforcement department, consumer protection department, and data security protection supervision department to work together, the purpose of enhancing market trust, ensuring consumer choice and consumer welfare can be realized.

articleTitle: Exploration of Knowledge Service Path of University Smart Library Based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: [Purpose/Meaning] With the development of the Internet of Things, cloud computing, and intelligent equipment, smart libraries can better meet the needs of users. [Method/Process] By analyzing the connotation of the knowledge service of the smart library, the path of the knowledge service of the smart library is proposed. [Results/Conclusions] The smart library can provide services for users through smart reference services, subject knowledge services, user self-service and full-process tracking service models.

articleTitle: Application of Modern Educational Technology in Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language: take mobile phone software Zoom platform as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: In 2020, due to the spread of the global COVID-19, the teaching of Chinese as a foreign language had been greatly affected. Many Chinese and foreign educational institutions at home and abroad or Confucius institutes have chosen to make full use of modern educational technology to choose the mode of online Chinese teaching. This paper mainly studies the application of modern educational technology in Chinese teaching during the epidemic situation, analyzes the mode of teaching Chinese as a foreign language during the COVID-19 situation, analyzes the mobile phone software zoom platform used by Chinese education institutions or Confucius Institutes at home and abroad, and summarizes the application's value, problems and solutions of online teaching of Chinese as a foreign language, and in the process of practicing the relevant teaching design, and it further studies how to make full use of the technical support of zoom platform and relevant media to make up for the lack of interaction in distance Chinese teaching, in order to better promote the development of Chinese as a foreign language and promote the internationalization of Chinese.

Author Keywords: teaching Chinese as a foreign language

articleTitle: A Practical Analysis of the Use of Information Technology to Solve Space-time Problems: —Take Traditional Chinese International Education as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The new crown epidemic has spread out since the beginning of 2020, and the online teaching model is gradually highlighting its own unique advantages in the field of education, accelerating the change of the traditional offline teaching-oriented approach. This paper, through the traditional offline teaching in the face of the epidemic encountered in-depth analysis, hopes to use the relevant information technology to find a solution to the problem. With teachers' own experience and a large number of reading literature, it is found that the traditional Chinese international education offline teaching model in the case of the epidemic is extremely serious, the biggest problem is the problem of education time and space. In the first part, the paper addresses the education space-time problems and the impacts in detail, then it illustrates how information technology can be used for online teaching to help solve the problems of the time and space in education, the second part combines with the relevant information technology to put forward corresponding coping strategies. Online teaching also has many shortcomings relative to the traditional offline teaching model, in the third part, it combines the author's own experience and related literature research on the effective evaluation of online teaching model, and put forwards relevant suggestions for its shortcomings.

articleTitle: The Development and Practice of Course Building Information Modeling Based on ADDIE Model
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Offering the course Building Information Modeling for architectural undergraduates is both necessary and urgent based on the rapid development of Building Information Modelling (BIM) as well as the building requirement of new engineering. On the basis of the ADDIE model design vision, this paper narrates the development process, building thought, implementation process, building outcome of the new course and direction that needs to be further improved. In accordance with the requirement of ability of employment with a focus on course goals, this paper designs the teaching content and teaching process, builds the course materials based on the Outcome Based Education (OBE) vision and Conceive, Design, Implement, Operation (CDIO) model so as to form muti-dimensional tracking assessment system. The two-term teaching practical effect proves that the development thought based on Building Information Modelling is correct and the implementation plan is feasible, which can provide certain references for new courses of Building Information Modelling.

articleTitle: On the teaching mode of the integration of teaching and learning of Higher Mathematics in the network era
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: In the information age with the rapid development of science and technology, college teachers are committed to studying how to make full use of the Internet to carry out teaching, but most of them focus on Teachers' teaching, but ignore students' learning. Teachers' teaching is for students to learn better. In order to highlight students' dominant position and improve students' desire for exploration and application ability of mathematical knowledge, this paper starts with teachers' teaching and students' learning, breaks the teaching mode of separating conventional teaching, relies on Internet technology, optimizes teaching content, enriches teaching forms, selects teaching tools Perfecting the evaluation mechanism and constructing a new model of teaching learning integration of higher mathematics; At the same time, the computer software MATLAB and dynamic mathematics software geogebra are fully used in the classroom, which makes the teaching content more intuitive, easier for students to understand, and effectively improves students' learning interest.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of the Internet Drug-purchasing Service for Middle-aged and Elderly Based on SHERPA and FMEA
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: This article aims to study the Internet drug-purchasing behavior of middle-aged and elderly groups to improve their satisfaction. The results show that the SHERPA and FMEA can effectively find out the defects of the design and pointedly bring up with suggestions for improvement. The suggestions are as follows: control the amount of information displayed, emphasize important information appropriately, and conform the operation process with the psychological cognition of users. The design iteration provides a more satisfactory experience for the groups, and reduces the difficulty of using Internet drug-purchasing service.

articleTitle: Application Research on the cultivation and construction of artificial intelligence innovation and entrepreneurship ability in the era of educational informatization 2.0
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of educational informatization and the continuous emergence of intelligent learning space, artificial intelligence, as an important part of smart campus, makes teachers' teaching and students' learning more accurate and efficient. As the learning content of innovation and entrepreneurship ability in the new era, students' personalized, convenient and diversified needs continue to highlight. According to the spirit of the informatization 2.0 action plan of the Ministry of education and other documents, the artificial intelligence virtual reality plan is used to assist the classroom teaching of innovation and entrepreneurship ability training. Aiming at “technology integration, discipline integration and teacher-student application integration”, this paper analyzes the problems existing in innovation and Entrepreneurship Education, and puts forward the construction of innovation and entrepreneurship ability training system based on the high-speed development situation of education informatization, Promote the improvement of College Students' innovation and entrepreneurship ability and provide a strong guarantee for colleges and universities to deepen the reform of innovation and entrepreneurship education.

articleTitle: Research on Curriculum Practice Teaching Reform of Information System Engineering Based on CDIO
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Information system engineering is an engineering discipline that comprehensively uses computer technology and engineering management principles and methods to realize the definition, design, development, testing, deployment, and operation and maintenance of specific function information system projects in accordance with user needs, budgets and schedules. Combining the CDIO's engineering practice teaching mode, aiming at the current situation that the form and content of the practice teaching of information system engineering courses are separated from actual engineering projects, a CDIO-based course practice teaching mode is proposed. The model was practiced with the life cycle of the information system engineering project as the carrier, and the results showed that the reform measures can better solve the above problems, and at the same time can improve students' independent learning and independent practice ability to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization of IT Project Development Based on Fuzzy Decision Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The objectives of complex projects are usually composed of multiple subsystems. These subsystems are relatively independent and have their own specific functions and operation objectives. If one-sided consideration of one of these objectives will reduce the coordination degree among subsystems and produce negative effects. Taking IT project development as an example, this paper constructs the target system of complex system collaborative development from three aspects of quality, time and cost. The fuzzy decision analysis method is used to determine the priority of each goal in the coordination degree model. The coordination degree model of quality, time, cost-effectiveness function and project objective of complex product system is constructed.

articleTitle: Intercultural Communication Strategies of Chinese Cultural Symbols via Online Videos
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The emergence of online short videos makes cultural communication more visualized and popular. At the same time online short videos realize the communication of cultural symbols among different cultures more effectively. This paper analyzes the practical significance of online short videos of new media in intercultural communication, discusses the rise and characteristics of online short videos and the meaning construction of Chinese cultural symbols from the intercultural perspective, and summarizes the strategies of constructing intercultural symbols through online short videos of new media.

articleTitle: Research on the Implementation of Informatization Teaching Based on Network Teaching Platform and flipped classroom
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: In order to realize the student-centered teaching model based on informatization teaching, this paper mainly discusses the implementation of informatization teaching based on network teaching platform and flipped classroom. Firstly the paper expounds the meaning of informatization teaching and its characteristics compared with traditional teaching; then introduces the implementation process based on network teaching platform and flipped classroom in detail from three phases-before class, during the class and after class; at last presents five strategies in the implementation process. It displays that the informatization teaching based on network teaching platform and flipped classroom can improve learning effect and realize the student-centered teaching model.

articleTitle: Research of the Blended Teaching Model of College English Writing Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The application and integration of artificial intelligence in English writing teaching is in the stage of research and innovation. In order to improve the quality of college English writing teaching, the article first explains the research background of the blended teaching model under the background of artificial intelligence, and then It discusses the application of mixed teaching mode in English writing teaching under the background of artificial intelligence from three aspects: before class, during class and after class. Introduction

articleTitle: Research on The Application of Information Technology in Equipment Courses Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Taking the equipment courses as the research object, according to the course content and teaching characteristics, it is divided into three typical directions: structure and principle, operation and maintenance. Taking the courses of structure and principle as an example, based on the analysis of their characteristics and existing problems, and considering the characteristics and applicable occasions of typical information technology, this paper puts forward the application of information technology means such as virtual reality technology, augmented reality technology and smart classroom to courses teaching. Then carry out the application research of relevant information technology in courses teaching from the aspects of teaching design, teaching implementation and teaching guarantee. The analysis of teaching effect shows that the application of corresponding information technology in each link of curriculum teaching can overcome the problems in the original curriculum teaching, give full play to the advantages of information technology, and achieve the purpose of improving teaching quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research analysis and suggestions on mobile Chinese learning APP Hello Chinese based on network and mobile devices
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: With the popularization of network and mobile devices all over the world, more and more Chinese learning is changing from offline to online. Recently, especially affected by the epidemic, offline teaching is almost interrupted, and many students begin to choose to use Chinese learning app. However, as a new learning method, there is little research, which brings difficulties for students to choose mobile Chinese learning app to learn Chinese. Based on the full use of Hello Chinese, this paper makes a detailed analysis of the app from the perspectives of pronunciation, vocabulary, grammar, Chinese characters, culture, etc. points out its advantages and disadvantages, especially some problems in the aspect of Chinese ontology, and on this basis, puts forward some improvement suggestions for the app developers, so as to make Hello Chinese more perfect and make students choose Chinese learning app is no longer blind, and ultimately can better serve for mobile Chinese learning.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of Open Sharing Management Mode of University Laboratories Based on Internet Informatization
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: To solve the common management problems in the open operational mode of laboratory, this thesis proposes an Internet and information-based management mechanism of sharing equipment. It offers offline/online support and guarantee of virtual reality, builds a vertical, hierarchical management model, thus making laboratory management more reasonable and efficient. In this management model, laboratory builds an ecological development system based on an Internet information technological data sharing platform.

articleTitle: Research on User Satisfaction of Otome Mobile Games Based on Web Data and LDA Model
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: In the increasingly competitive environment of the market for mobile games, it is of great importance to effectively understand the factors influencing user satisfaction and improve the game experience of players. But traditional user research methods such as surveys cannot keep up with the information age easily, and the application of computing science on otome mobile games is still underexplored. In our study, we applied text processing, term-frequency statistics, and feature mining to Web review data, combined with the LDA model, to distill factors influencing user satisfaction of otome mobile games. Finally, through the statistical results of questionnaires, the rationality of the conclusion was verified. This paper provides an effective method for game developers to improve the research and satisfaction of players towards otome mobile games.

articleTitle: Research on the Enlightenment of SPOC in The COVID-19 Global Pandemic Based on TCSL Online Classes
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The outbreak of COVID-19 pandemic in 2020 has caused incalculable losses to all walks of life around the world, which inevitably brought negative effects to the development of TCSL with the halt of export of teachers and the normal teaching of TCSL classes abroad. In this critical period, online teaching mode began to play an essential role and Massive Open Online Course, the product of “Internet+Education” MOOC has become the very first choice of TCSL online classes. Admitting the dominant position of it, progress still needs to be made in precision of online TCSL classes. In view of the present situation and the condition that SPOC, as a small private online course mode, which has achieved gratifying results in many other subjects while there is still potential for practicing in the field of TCSL, applying the method of data investigation and flow design, combining with the characteristics of Internet Education in Digital Age, feasibility of practicing SPOC teaching mode in HSK online classes under the COVID-19 global pandemic and reflection of putting SPOC into practice will be discussed in this article, which is to provide a reference for the application of SPOC teaching mode in TCSL and provide more feasible examples for the combination of digitization and humanity education.

articleTitle: Research on block-chain teaching based on goal oriented and flipped classroom
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Taking the teaching of block-chain principle and technology as an example, an innovative hybrid teaching method based on goal-oriented and flipped classroom is proposed. The traditional teaching methods is reformed in the proposed method, which combines two new teaching modes for goal orientation and flipped classroom, and applies them to the curriculum teaching practice of block-chain principle and technology. This method first groups the students according to the teaching content of the block-chain principle and technology and the number of students in the class, assigns the corresponding learning tasks, and puts forward the learning priorities and difficulties corresponding to the curriculum learning tasks, as well as the curriculum knowledge points to be understood. The group members study and discuss according to the course learning tasks, and display the learning results in the classroom. The instructor evaluates the courseware and content explanation made by the students, points out the shortcomings of the students in knowledge understanding and explanation, and explains in detail the deficiencies and places that need to be further emphasized or added content, then discuss and communicate with the whole class to make the students fully understand and master the knowledge. Compared with the traditional teaching methods, the method provided in this paper can play better teaching effects in cultivation and improvement of students' abilities such as teamwork, independent thinking, autonomous learning and self-expression.

articleTitle: A Case Study of Student-Teacher Interaction in Chinese Classrooms at Brigham Young University, USA based on FIAS
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: This study uses the Flanders Interaction Analysis System (FIAS) to conduct a case study of Chinese language classes at Brigham Young University in the United States. Based on the video observation of the classroom, an interaction behaviour matrix was used to quantify the teaching style, teacher-student question and answer data, with the aim of summarising the characteristics of teacher-student interaction behaviour in the classroom environment where Chinese is taught by native American teachers, and to consider the Chinese classroom in China based on the principle of “taking the best and removing the worst”.

articleTitle: Application of TTS Technology in Online Teaching of Chinese as a Foreign Language
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, information technology is widely used. Influenced by this, the international education of Chinese has gradually developed a variety of online teaching models. In the new era, how to use computer aided technology to carry out online teaching of Chinese as a foreign language is a topic worthy of further study. As a convenient and fast speech synthesis technology, TTS technology has brought convenience to People's Daily life, but it has not been widely used in the field of education. Through a brief overview of TTS technology, this paper discusses the great advantages of TTS voice application in online teaching of Chinese as a foreign language, which is conducive to improving the innovation of online teaching of Chinese as a foreign language.

Author Keywords: Teaching Chinese as a Second Language

articleTitle: Study on Relationship between Reopening Time and Per Price and Number of Comments Based on Regression Analysis and Adjustment Effect Test
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Since the outbreak of COVID-19, it has had a direct and profound impact on social production and people's lives. The national economy has even stopped for a while, and the catering industry is one of the most obvious industries. This paper collects the store information and comments of the public comment platform from December 2019 to September 2020. In terms of comments, word vector is constructed by word 2vec algorithm, and the thesaurus of epidemic prevention measures is obtained by cluster analysis; In terms of data, in addition to obtaining the detailed page information of public comments, the time period for all catering stores to close down and the time interval for store reopening shall be determined according to the monthly comments. Finally, the mechanism of the number of online reviews, per price and epidemic prevention measures affecting the reopening time is discussed by using regression equation analysis. The results show that the number of online reviews represents that the stores have a certain anti risk ability to a certain extent, so that catering enterprises can resume business quickly; The higher price positioning of stores can meet the safety psychology of consumers during the epidemic.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of the Online and Offline Teaching Mode of Computer Practice Course under the Standard of “Golden Course”
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Under the background of “Golden Course” construction, in order to stimulate college students' interest in “Multimedia Courseware Production” and improve their skills in courseware production, the essay explores the teaching mode of computer practice courses by online and offline hybrid teaching. The task-driven teaching approach and practical exercise approach are adopted in the course. The course fully excavates the ideological and political elements from given task content and organically integrates knowledge, abilities and quality objectives. In order to cultivate students' comprehensive ability and advanced thinking to solve complex problems, the teaching objectives of the course are set with the characteristics of high level, innovation and challenge.

articleTitle: An investigation on college students' learning of online hybrid Korean elective courses Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Under the background of “Internet plus”, information teaching has been paid more and more attention, and online autonomous learning has become an important way of learning. The combination of Korean elective courses and network technology resources is generally adopted in the form of hybrid teaching. As new technologies and forms bring convenience, new problems will also arise. Only by investigating the actual situation of students' online learning progress and effect, learning motivation, finding out the core of the problem and dealing with it reasonably, can we truly realize the win-win situation of convenience and effectiveness of online and offline mixed teaching.

articleTitle: A Visualized Analysis of Chinese Teaching Research in Mongolia Based on CNKI
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The rapid development of information technology provides technical support for the visualization analysis of data.
