The definition of visual analysis method is to use software and scientometrics to conduct statistical analysis on a large number of information and make a complete analysis chart, so as to make the complex information intuitive and analyze the potential rules. In this paper, the research literature on Chinese teaching in Mongolia in the CNKI journal database from 2003 to 2020 is taken as the research object. Through the visualization analysis of CNKI, the influential institutions, research developments and hot spots in the field of Mongolian Chinese teaching and research are summarized. This will provide a new perspective for the future research for the relevant scholars in this field and promote the Chinese teaching in Mongolia.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Career Planning for University Students based on SPSS Statistical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Career planning is crucial in helping students to improve their career awareness and employability. This study conducted a quantitative study with 433 questionnaires (M=208, F=225, Mage=21.6) on the situations of university students' career planning. Correlation analysis, difference analysis and cluster analysis (K-means algorithm and Pam algorithm) were used with SPSS statistics software to understand their status in four indicators–self-understanding., status assessment., career exploration and decision action.

articleTitle: Application and method analysis of cloud education technology in product art design education
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Cloud computing technology is a kind of intensive computing mode with data and processing capability as the core. It mainly integrates various ICT technologies and is the product of traditional technologies. Cloud computing technology mainly includes large-scale data management technology, virtualization technology, distributed data storage technology, programming technology, information management, cloud computing management platform technology and distributed resource management. Cloud computing technology is widely used in product art design. To analyze the structure model of product art design system and construct a complete product three-dimensional model is mainly to use distributed data storage technology to integrate the data information obtained from product art design, and then design and develop the product data results. Among them, cloud computing technology adopts various engineering technologies in product art design and uses three-dimensional modeling to help product art design establish intelligent modules. The application of cloud computing technology promotes the progress of product art design education and meets the demand of product art design for technical education.

articleTitle: Visual comparative analysis of online Chinese teaching based on CNKI literature
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: With the spread of COVID-19, online Chinese teaching has been booming worldwide, and the study of online Chinese teaching has also increased. Visual analysis is a theory, method and technology that uses computer graphics and image processing technology to transform data into graphics or images displayed on screen and then interactive processing. This paper takes 46 core journal papers in CNKI database as the data pool, and draws the knowledge map of online Chinese teaching research by using geographic information sysem geographic information system and text cloud generator, micro word cloud. Through the analysis of co occurrence of core authors, publishing institutions, and the publishing area and cluster analysis of key words, the current situation, hot spots and evolution trend of online Chinese teaching before and after the epidemic are compared. It is a new field to study Chinese teaching in the future. More scholars will invest in and improve the mechanism of online Chinese teaching. Hope to provide ideas for the scholars who study online Chinese teaching later.

articleTitle: Analysis of M-learning application in Chinese Learning: Take hellotalk as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: M-learning is mobile learning, generally relying on wireless network and multimedia technology, using mobile phones, laptops and other wireless devices to achieve interactive teaching activities. [1] In this era, with the rapid development of information technology, wireless network technology is becoming more and more mature, and almost every person has a smart phone, this mode of using mobile devices to teach is becoming more and more popular. Taking hellotalk as an example, this paper first expounds the current development of modern educational technology in teaching Chinese as a foreign language, and then summarizes the current situation of the application of mobile software in teaching Chinese as a foreign language. Then it briefly introduces the functions of hellotalk and analyzes its advantages and disadvantages in application. Finally, it puts forward some suggestions on the learning software combined with teaching Chinese as a foreign language, hoping to learn this way. Learning software can be further improved, so as to promote TCFL more diversified.

Author Keywords: teaching Chinese as a foreign language

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis and Discussion on Factors Affecting Emotional Experience of Online Learners
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: There emerged the poor emotional experience for online learners in the classroom teaching empowered by information technology. Through teaching practice of and investigation on three classes with different online teaching forms, Spearman's p-correlation analysis showed that the challenge and the relevance of online learning content were highly positively related to learners' emotional engagement, their senses of learning effectiveness and the difficulty of learning content were moderately positively related to emotional engagement. Multiple linear regression showed that both cognitive and behavioral engagements positively and significantly predicted emotional engagement, and a standardized regression formulation was derived. Based on the above study, the implementation of emotional motivation strategy, emotional scaffolding strategy, emotional identification strategy, and emotional exchange strategy will enhance online learners' experience and achieve the expected online learning outcomes.

articleTitle: Design of practice management system based on Web
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of repeated infringement of labor rights and interests in the process of college students' practice, through demand analysis, web-based system model, B/S architecture, the database model structure and data table are designed in detail, and the practice information management module is designed in detail by combining static and dynamic modeling. The system has a better reflection of the internship situation of students, can have a binding effect on the internship units and universities, can effectively reduce the labor rights and interests of college interns in the process of internship infringement problem, for interns to provide new protection of labor rights and interests.

articleTitle: Application of computer technology in Piano Teaching in Normal Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: Based on the resource integration and resource coordination of computer technology, piano teaching, as a discipline, will effectively use computer technology to mine valuable data information for teaching from massive data. The application of computer technology has subverted and promoted the traditional piano teaching mode in normal universities. Due to the new system analysis algorithm added by computer technology in the teaching process of piano teaching in normal universities, with the continuous expansion of the amount of data in piano teaching, the requirements for the system storage performance and operation speed of piano teaching in normal universities are also increasing. In order to further improve the comprehensive performance of computer technology in the piano teaching system model of normal universities, this paper proposes a hybrid model learning method, which is a hybrid incremental learning method using computer a model and data. This method can quickly carry out professional teaching for learners, and establish a dynamic learning scheme for learners through data analysis.

articleTitle: Teaching Chinese as a foreign language under the background of the Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The Internet era has become more dependent on interaction under the Internet, and with the expansion of China's international comprehensive strength, the boom in learning Chinese has gained momentum, making the threshold for learning Chinese lower and lower for learners from all walks of life. Due to the impact of the epidemic, the main position of teaching Chinese as a foreign language at home and abroad has also shifted from offline to online. The characteristics of Chinese classes for foreigners in the Internet context are very different from those of traditional Chinese classes for foreigners, mainly in terms of course length, teacher composition, teaching methods, classroom organization and management, and teaching media. In this paper, we first analyze the articles related to teaching Chinese as a foreign language classroom, online teaching classroom, and overseas online Chinese classroom research by using the visual analysis of China Knowledge Network, and then analyze the characteristics of online Chinese teaching by observing the popular Chinese teaching videos on foreign websites, and the similarities and differences among the existing online teaching models, and suggest improvements for future development.

articleTitle: Construction of Sports Archives System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: At present, the application of blockchain technology has been relatively extensive, and great achievements have been made in the application of finance related fields. There is still a lot of room for development to apply blockchain technology to sports. Through literature and case analysis, this paper analyzes the existing problems in China's current sports archives information system, and combined with expert interview, identifies the areas that blockchain technology could help to complement. Researchers explain the design idea of the new system from six design elements: system user, function, structure, data structure and data analysis. Through research, the application value and implementation path of sports archives system based on blockchain technology in identity authentication, archives traceability, security protection and so on are obtained.

articleTitle: Content Analysis of Chinese Netizens' Public Opinion Based on Internet Comments: Case study of 160,000+ comments from Guan Video - a social political channel followed by four million people
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: When a social event is reported, public opinions that an individual could access are predominantly limited by mainstream newspapers, social media, and how they portray the voice of their audiences. Recommendation algorithms from those platforms could be biased based on those channels' political standpoints. Therefore, the comments under news sections could be manipulated and not serve as an optimal proxy for reflecting public opinions. Social groups with different interests and standpoints are constantly conflicting with others. The measurement of social opinion can help us study the social demands behind public opinion and the social conflicts that come with the demands. Thus, content analysis of comments on Internet news articles proves effective in quantifying and understanding the different demands and conflicts in society more accurately, making it possible to govern a more developed and complex society. Carrying the goal to visualize abstract and subjective social opinions into measurable data, and to prove the effectiveness of applying data in assisting social studies, this research analyzes 160,000+ internet comments from Guan Video, a social-political channel that is followed by four million people through the Chinese video platform Bilibili, which has over 223 million Chinese users. With machine learnings IF-IDF model and Word2Vec model, this research proves the effectiveness of applying innovative quantitative measures in social research through the case study of netizens' opinions on education topics. Furthermore, we hope this research inspires further quantitative studies in humanity and society with the assistance of Natural Language Processing and other technologies.

articleTitle: Construction of Sports Information Service System for the Disabled from the Perspective of National Fitness
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: This paper aims at putting forward some suggestions on the construction of sports information service system for the disabled mainly with the literature method and combined with field investigation data. The research results indicate that the participants of sports for the disabled in China show a diversified development trend, the supply of sports resources for the disabled is less, and the sports services for the disabled is scarce. Therefore, in order to achieve the goal of national fitness, it is urgent to establish the sports information service system for the disabled. Based on field investigation, to better construct the sports information service system for the disabled, the paper puts forward the following three suggestions: 1) to give full play to the subjective initiative of social sports organizations to expand the participation of the platform; 2) to actively use the development mode driven by the partial advantage of physical education teaching to improve the shareability of the platform; and 3) to highly integrate university sports venue resources to enhance the operability of the platform.

articleTitle: Preface ITEI 2021
publicationTitle: 2021 3rd International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI)
abstract: The 2021 International Conference on Internet Technology and Educational Informization (ITEI 2021) was be held virtually online on December 10-12, 2021 due to the precaution taken to minimizing the COVID-19 risk. The safety and well-being of all conference participants was our first and top priority, while we strived to offer many scholars and researchers this long-awaited conference to conduct academic exchanges with their peers. ITEI 2021 looks for significant contributions to all major fields of the Educational and Information Technology in theoretical and practical aspects. The aim of the conference is to provide a platform to the researchers and practitioners from both academia as well as industry to meet and share cutting-edge development in the field. The COVID-19 virus has made our life very challenging, but we want to reiterate that there are no barriers to science, as we continue to do our research works via modern technical means. The ITEI 2021 has selected Zoom as the virtual platform. Each presenter were given a 15-30 minutes talk and followed by a short discussion afterward. Before the conference, all the authors were encouraged to submit a video as a backup in case of unexpected technical problems. There were 160 individuals who attended this on-line conference, represented many countries including China, Malaysia, Singapore and UK. During the conference, we invited four professors as our keynote speakers. Prof. Liu Nian, North China Electric Power University, China, performed a speech: Optimal Energy Management for Integrated Energy Systems. And then we had Prof. Huize Zhan, School of Information Technology in Education, South China Normal University. She delivered a speech: Blended learning and the emerging technologies in the intelligence age. Prof. Qingshan Xu, Southeast University, China. His research area is Intelligent power distribution. Lastly, we were glad to invite Prof. Xiaohui Zou, Sino-US Searle Research Center, Zhuhai Hengqin Searle Technology Co., Ltd. He shared a speech: How to steadily improve the teaching quality with human-computer collaboration? Their insightful speeches had triggered heated discussion of the conference. Every participant praised this conference for disseminating useful and insightful knowledge. The proceedings are a compilation of the accepted papers and represent an interesting outcome of the conference. Topics include but are not limited to the following areas: Computer Engineering and Information Technology, Educational Models and Methods, Inclusive Learning and other related topics. All the papers have been through rigorous review and process to meet the requirements of international publication standard. We would like to acknowledge all of those who supported ITEI 2021. The help and contribution of each individual and institution was instrumental in the success of the conference. In particular, we would like to thank the organizing committee for its valuable inputs in shaping the conference program and reviewing the submitted papers. The Committee of ITEI 2021
